name: Do I need a permit for deck repair in Alameda, CA?
description: Permits for deck repair in Alameda, CA, are typically needed for structural changes, but not for minor surface repairs.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for deck repair in Alameda, CA?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you need a permit for deck repair in Alameda, CA, depends on the scope of the work. Minor repairs like replacing a few surface boards or painting typically do not require a permit. However, if the repair involves structural changes, such as replacing support posts, joists, or enlarging the deck footprint, a permit from the City of Alameda Planning and Building Department will likely be necessary. Hometelligent Inc. can help you determine permit requirements.
